content.short: Disintar is a social NFT marketplace on TON that makes it easy for creators to launch and users to discover art.
content.description: Disintar is a 'social' NFT marketplace built on the TON blockchain, designed to lower the barrier to entry for both digital creators and collectors. It provides an intuitive platform where users can easily mint, list, and trade NFTs while also following their favorite artists and discovering new collections through a social-style feed. Disintar emphasizes the social aspect of digital ownership, fostering a vibrant community where art discovery and interaction are as important as the transactions themselves.
content.meta: Join the social NFT revolution on Disintar. Mint and discover art on the TON blockchain via Lancers Web3 Explorer.
